import pandas as pd

# Define file paths
source0_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_0.csv'
source1_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_1.csv'
target_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/target_multisource_cot.csv'

# Load Source 0
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Select first 500 rows from Source 0 to match Source 1 row count
df_source0_subset = df_source0.iloc[:500].copy()

# Rename columns according to target schema
df_source0_subset.rename(columns={'0': '0_x'}, inplace=True)
df_source1.rename(columns={'0': '0_y'}, inplace=True)

# Drop 'right_index' from Source 0 as it's not needed in target
df_source0_subset.drop(columns=['right_index'], inplace=True)

# Concatenate the two dataframes column-wise
df_target = pd.concat([df_source0_subset.reset_index(drop=True), df_source1.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)

# Ensure the target dataframe has the correct columns and types
df_target = df_target[['0_x', '0_y']]
df_target = df_target.astype({'0_x': float, '0_y': float})

# Save the target dataframe to CSV
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
